about.text: A traditional brined cheese with a sharp, salty flavor and firm, slightly brittle texture, aged in brine and shaped into blocks or truncated cones.

sources.text: Wikipedia gives minimum 60 days, a retailer says 1-2 months; upper bound approximate
Wikipedia gives minimum 60 days, a retailer says 1-2 months; upper bound approximate

facts.v: Can be soaked in fresh water to reduce the salt
Kept in pots or jars of brine, with the same brine ageing as Lori cheese
